Berserk lasts 5 Rounds. Without an FBC or Cyberspine, −4 to ranged attacks while it runs. While it runs, any of these can be half of a ROF2 Action: grab or drop a shield, get up, Grab, Human Shield, activate gear or chrome, clear a jam, put yourself out, stow a weapon. Once a Round, a Brawling, Martial Arts or melee hit that deals 4+ damage after armor counts as two hits for Martial Arts prerequisites.

Runs: Berserk

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
